$comment: The Claude Code mods Agentmaster ships inside TerminalApp.dll and loads into every Claude tab it launches (doc/agentmaster/BUNDLED_MODS.md). Listed in --plugin-dir order. After editing a mod here, or this file, run `python tools/bundled-mods/bundled_mods.py gen`; to take a newer copy from the source folder, `sync` first. minClaudeCode is the oldest Claude Code that runs the mod (Agentmaster passes it only to a claude.exe at least that new); summary is the line the cog's Claude tab shows.

mods.name: file-links
mods.summary: Draws the file paths and file names in Claude's replies as clickable file:/// links (only names it finds on disk).

mods.name: better-verbose-bash
mods.summary: In verbose views (--verbose, Verbose output, ctrl+o), the reason given for a shell call becomes its row's header.
